notes.text: Elijah was a prophet and miracle worker who lived in the northern kingdom of Israel during the reign of King Ahab, according to the Books of Kings in the Hebrew Bible.
Elijah is remembered as a religious figure connected with Israel.
Elijah's recorded life dates place this profile around -1000--900.
Elijah is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
Elijah's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Israel historical setting.
